source.name: Justified
source.originalDescription: When the user is damaged, their attack stat increases by 8% for 4s up to 4 times.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Justified には、直接ダメージや単純移動以外の特殊効果を検出していません。

damageFormula.trueDescription: When the user is damaged, their attack stat increases by 8% for 4s up to 4 times.

baseAction.notes: 直接ダメージと単純移動はbaseActionへ保存し、特殊効果件数には含めない。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with increased range every third attack, hitting twice. The first hit damages opposing Pokémon with a normal basic attack; the second hit is a follow-up attack with a bone, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area a second time and throwing them for 0.5s.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 相手を打ち上げる、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる。

source.name: Aura Cannon
source.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and channels aura into a huge sphere, then launches the sphere in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in its path. The aura sphere picks up speed as it travels; at close range, a target can be hit up to 4 times, while at max speed a target will only be hit once. After unleashing this move the user mega evolves for 25s adding additional effects to Close Combat and Power-Up Punch and changing the passive ability to Adaptability. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Aura Cannon は 妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。
